decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen won repeated gold awards from the Deutsches Brotinstitut and is a seasonal flagship close to the core offer, so keeping it costs little.
The dark barley malt rye bread has kept its own page through 2024 while the sibling breads were dropped, which suggests it survived the assortment cleanup.
The marzipan stollen complements the award-winning stollen line in the seasonal gift assortment and is still shown on its own page in 2024.
